name: Cross Works Ltd
project_role: Overall masterplanner and lead consultant for New Tashkent; authored the District 1 Detailed Masterplan (approved June 2024) and oversees a multi-firm consortium (Buro Happold, Gillespies, BuroAtlas, KPMG Uzbekistan and others) delivering the city's digital twin and urban design.
exhibition_evidence: UK-based design studio (London); no evidence of a physical showroom/exhibition space in Uzbekistan, works through the New Tashkent Directorate.
address: London, United Kingdom (project office linked to New Tashkent Directorate, Tashkent)
key_messages: Masterplan for a 25,000-hectare, 2.5 million-resident 'twin city' east of Tashkent
District 1 Detailed Masterplan officially approved June 2024
Leads a multidisciplinary international consortium (engineering, landscape, advisory) for New Tashkent
raw_notes: Led by architect/urban planner Hakan Ceyhan Agca. First phase covers ~6,000 ha (target 2045); District 1 detailed plan covers a subset of that. Project overall targets 2.5M residents on 25,000 ha; government figures cite up to 19,720-20,000 ha total. Officially listed as a partner on newtashkent.uz.

Official partner of the New Tashkent Directorate (quote from Simon Pilkington)
raw_notes: Named consortium member under Cross Works' New Tashkent District 1 masterplan team, alongside Gillespies, KPMG Uzbekistan and BuroAtlas.

name: Gillespies
